Game Overview

Cursed Treasure - Level Pack! is a strategy game built around command orcs, demons, and the undead in a thrilling tower defense as an evil overlord. Protect your gems from wave after wave of hero invaders, strategically placing and upgrading your dark forces. Enjoy a fresh, challenging experience with new levels and tactical decision-making in this darkly delightful game.

Cursed Treasure - Level Pack! keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Command orcs, demons, and the undead in a thrilling tower defense as an evil overlord!
